6.256 rsInconsistentNumberOfCellsInRow
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInconsistentNumberOfCellsInRow is a critical error that will occur when two or more TablixRow
elements within the same TablixRows collection contain a different number of TablixCell elements. Or,
this error will occur when two or more TablixCornerRow elements within the same TablixCornerRows
collection contain a different number of TablixCornerCell elements.
